reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)

sources.label: Apollo underlying fund June 30, 2026 semiannual report

reserveReview.rationale: ACRED is a permissioned feeder share into Apollo Diversified Credit Fund; its Ethereum deployment uses Securitize DSToken rather than an ERC-4626 vault. The configured Chainlink NAV adapter values the fund-share reserve. The underlying fund's June 30, 2026 SEC report publishes a dated consolidated investment schedule and strategy allocations. Those underlying-fund figures do not establish the tokenized feeder's own dated allocation or cash balance, so the existing fund-share composition and date are retained without extrapolating a feeder-level split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chainlink ACRED NAV oracle (the configured live-reserve surface) and Securitize fund disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The June 30, 2026 SEC schedule publishes dated position descriptions, principal amounts, rates, maturities, values, and portfolio totals. Remaining unknown exposure is limited to changes after that report date and any classifications or feeder-level details not disclosed in the filing.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The underlying fund publishes dated constituent values, but a measured look-through allocation for the tokenized feeder and its own cash balance has not been established.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)

sources.label: Apollo underlying fund prospectus: custodian and rehypothecation

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The underlying Apollo Diversified Credit Fund prospectus names Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, National Association as custodian and permits BNP to rehypothecate pledged portfolio securities up to the outstanding loan balance, subject to conditions. These are underlying-fund facts, not proof of the tokenized feeder's own custody accounts or provider shares. Feeder-level segregation and bankruptcy-remoteness terms remain unverified.
